description: Mining Tenements (DMIRS-003) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Energy, Mines, Industry Regulation and Safety. Live and Pending Mining Tenement Data referencing both surveyed and unsurveyed mining tenements as they appear spatially within the Department of Energy, Mines, Industry Regulation and Safety TENGRAPH system. This dataset was formally known as Mining Tenements (DMP-003). Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Energy, Mines, Industry Regulation and Safety. Its tags are Harvested, SLIP Future, business, economy, exploration. It offers 8 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage, shp. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
